reviews.text: I wanted a fluffy and light pink (but not bright) color and this is exactly like the name of its shade! The formula is pretty nice but I was surprised by how long-lasting and pigmented the color is!
reviews.zh: 我想要嘅係粉嫩又淡嘅粉紅色（但唔係鮮色），呢個完全同佢個色號名一樣！質地都幾好，不過持久度同顯色度都令我好驚喜！

reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Plum in Cream Cheese (+Mellow Lip Oil Keyring 02)
reviews.text: I love the color but the formula can be a little clumpy if it’s applied on top of other products. Makes it a little tricky when I want to just apply and not worry about it.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個顏色，但如果疊喺其他產品上面，質地會有少少結塊。想搽完唔使再理佢嘅時候，會有少少麻煩。

reviews.text: Soft application and blurring. Love the texture and shade. I made a mistake of purchasing only the milky blur fondue bar, i would repurchase to get with gloss. I only wish the product was a bit more. Product is less than half. There is slight scent to this product. Shade on the left is 4 plum in cream cheese.
reviews.zh: 上妝柔軟，有磨皮感。鍾意呢個質地同色號。我淨係買咗 milky blur fondue bar 係一個錯誤，應該連唇釉一齊買返。我只係希望份量多少少，產品份量少過一半。呢個產品有少少香味。左邊色號係 4 plum in cream cheese。

reviews.text: I was surprised how the product applied as soft velvety texture. Beautiful color and would look amazing on spring warm tone. I’m only disappointed for the amount of product, wish there was little more. Shade 3 fig in caramel on the right.
reviews.zh: 產品上妝係柔軟嘅絲絨質地，令我好驚喜。顏色靚，喺春季暖調嘅膚色上面應該會好出色。唯一失望嘅係產品份量，希望再多少。右邊色號係 3 fig in caramel。

reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Plum in Cream Cheese (+Mellow Lip Oil Keyring 02)
reviews.text: Love love love! The fondue by itself has a really natural colour and personally matches my natural lip colour so it isn’t a striking look. I personally love it more with the lip oil so I am glad that was a gift with it 😂
reviews.zh: 超超超鍾意！淨係 fondue 本身已經係好自然嘅顏色，個人嚟講同我本身唇色好夾，所以唔會好搶眼。我自己就更鍾意配埋 lip oil，所以慶幸佢係跟嚟嘅贈品 😂

reviews.shade: [SET] 04 Plum in Cream Cheese (+Mellow Lip Oil Keyring 02)
reviews.text: This one came with a gloss! It doesn't really have a smell compared to the lipstick and it actually doesn't come with a lot of product. It almost feels empty upon squeezing it. The gloss feels very nice and not sticky! The lipstick is very cool toned compared to the fig color and pairs well with it's gloss.
reviews.zh: 呢個有跟 gloss！同支唇筆比起冇咩味道，而且產品份量都唔多，揸落去幾乎係空嘅感覺。Gloss 質感好正又唔黐笠！比起 fig 色，呢支唇筆冷調好多，同佢個 gloss 好夾。

reviews.text: Smells like strawberries! I basically bought all the colors cuz the formula and the SCENT really sold me. It doesn't stay on your lips too long, but it makes for an easy touch up lipstick that you don't have to worry about fumbling around with an applicator wand.
reviews.zh: 有士多啤梨味！我基本上買晒所有顏色，因為質地同香味真係好吸引我。喺唇上唔算持久，但係好方便補妝，唔使成日搞支掃頭。

reviews.shade: [SET] 03 Fig in Caramel (+Mellow Lip Oil Keyring 01)
reviews.text:
are you kidding me??? IT SMELLS LIKE STRAWBERRIES 🍓 

IMMEDIATELY YES

I would say that the only thing i don’t like about this lippie is that it’s not very long lasting, BUT the consistency is very soft and creamy. it’s easy to blend!
reviews.zh:
你冇搞錯呀？？？有士多啤梨味🍓

即刻收貨！

我會話呢支唇妝唯一唔鍾意嘅係唔算持久，不過質地好柔軟 creamy，好容易 blend 開！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
